# osc_eyevinn_open_videocore (Resource)

Unlock the potential of your media assets with Open Videocore, the headless MAM solution that seamlessly scales in the cloud. Effortlessly manage, transcode, package, and deliver content with a single API call!
Open Videocore provisions additional OSC service instances (transcoding, storage, database) depending on the stack you configure it to build — the token rate shown here covers this middleware service only; each instance it provisions is billed separately at its own rate.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `couchdb_admin_password` (String) Database connection configuration
- `minio_root_password` (String) Configuration option for miniorootpassword
- `name` (String) Name of open-videocore
- `osc_access_token` (String) Configuration option for oscaccesstoken
- `parameter_store` (String) Configuration option for parameterstore
- `parameter_store_api_key` (String) API key for authentication

### Optional

- `encore_idle_timeout_ms` (String) Timeout value in milliseconds or seconds
- `encore_max_instances` (String) Configuration option for encoremaxinstances
- `encore_min_instances` (String) Configuration option for encoremininstances

### Read-Only

- `external_ip` (String) The external Ip of the created instance (if available).
- `external_port` (Number) The external Port of the created instance (if available).
- `instance_url` (String) URL to the created instace
- `service_id` (String) The service id for the created instance
